document: Universal Mobile Control — Current Batch Audit Chronology

basis.rule: Source facts, runtime evidence and inference are kept separate.

back.evidence: Earlier direct bridge test was reported by the user as working.

tap.evidence: Latest known test returned 'tap callback timeout'.

swipe.evidence: Latest known test returned 'swipe callback timeout'.

installation.evidence: APK artifact exists, but artifact presence does not prove installation or Accessibility Service restart.

chronology.event: Current Universal Mobile Control source batch inspected.
chronology.result: Java service, accessibility XML, manifest, Gradle configuration and debug APK are present.
Window content retrieval, screenshot capture and gesture capability are declared.
Screenshot is converted to a software bitmap; UI tree and Latin/Devanagari OCR are placed into the cached JSON result.
Action Mode starts OCR/screenshot refresh every 3000 ms and schedules a 400 ms post-action refresh.
Tap and swipe pass gesture callbacks to HandlerThread UMC-GestureCallbacks rather than the main handler.
dispatchGesture() acceptance is distinct from callback completion; timeout remains possible and latest known test timed out.
dispatchGesture() acceptance is distinct from callback completion; latest known test timed out.
performGlobalAction(GLOBAL_ACTION_BACK) is used; earlier user test confirmed Back worked.
The /type endpoint searches FOCUS_INPUT, requires an editable node, and uses ACTION_SET_TEXT.
The bridge writes HTTP 200 for both success and application-level error JSON; JSON status/message is authoritative.
/screen returns cached latestJson; /scan requests a new asynchronous scan and enables Action Mode.
Action Mode can schedule repeated scans while a previous screenshot/OCR pipeline may still be running; recognizers are created per scan.
No /home endpoint exists in the current Java bridge; Home must not be counted as a supported bridge endpoint.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe are not runtime-verified because callback completion has timed out.
audit_findings.correction: Do not report success from HTTP 200 or dispatchGesture() acceptance. Verify callback completion and a fresh post-action screen.

audit_findings.finding: The HTTP layer always emits 200 even when the JSON body has status=error.
audit_findings.correction: Keep JSON status/message authoritative for now; later return appropriate HTTP error codes.

audit_findings.finding: Action Mode can start a new screenshot/OCR cycle every 3000 ms without an explicit in-flight scan guard.
audit_findings.correction: Add a single-flight scan lock/state so only one screenshot/OCR pipeline is active at a time.

audit_findings.finding: Tap/swipe call startActionMode(), which immediately initiates a scan before dispatching the gesture.
audit_findings.correction: Separate action execution from vision refresh; execute the gesture first, then schedule the verification scan.

audit_findings.finding: A new Latin and Devanagari TextRecognizer is created for every scan.
audit_findings.correction: Reuse recognizers for the service lifetime and close them in onDestroy().
Use relevant accessibility events to invalidate or refresh cached UI state when live UI updates are needed.
Do not add Home to the supported API list until it is implemented and tested.

audit_findings.finding: APK existence does not prove the installed service is the current build.
audit_findings.correction: After installation, disable/re-enable the Accessibility Service and verify /action/status plus a fresh /scan before gesture testing.

corrected_truth_table./screen: cached vision state; not a fresh scan
corrected_truth_table./scan: asynchronous scan request; result must be polled
corrected_truth_table./type: implemented through focused editable AccessibilityNodeInfo; current runtime result not independently verified in this audit
corrected_truth_table.HTTP_200: NOT sufficient proof of action success

verification_protocol.level_2_acceptance: Accessibility API accepts the requested action
verification_protocol.level_4_visual_verification: Fresh /screen result proves the expected UI change
verification_protocol.rule: Only level 4 is a fully verified phone action.

next_correction_priority: Diagnose why gesture callbacks time out.
Move gesture execution before verification scanning.
Implement /home only if required, then test it.
